mapper.insert: INSERT INTO post_comment ( post_id, user_id, contents, created_at ) VALUES ( #{postId,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{userId,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{content,jdbcType=CLOB}, SYSTIMESTAMP )
mapper.select: SELECT c.comment_id AS commentId, c.post_id AS postId, c.user_id AS userId, u.name AS nickname, CASE WHEN c.user_id = p.user_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS isAuthor, c.contents AS content, c.created_at AS createdAt FROM post_comment c JOIN app_user u ON u.user_id = c.user_id JOIN post p ON p.post_id = c.post_id WHERE c.post_id = #{postId,jdbcType=NUMERIC} AND p.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY c.created_at ASC, c.comment_id ASC

SELECT c.comment_id AS commentId, c.post_id AS postId, c.user_id AS userId, u.name AS nickname, CASE WHEN c.user_id = p.user_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS isAuthor, c.contents AS content, c.created_at AS createdAt FROM post_comment c JOIN app_user u ON u.user_id = c.user_id JOIN post p ON p.post_id = c.post_id WHERE c.comment_id = #{commentId,jdbcType=NUMERIC}
